notes.title: 15+ Update, Standing CG Replacements, and New Resource Additions
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Torriet.

Here are the details of the latest major updates for Four Lights.
[hr][/hr]1. Age Rating Adjustment (15+)
Four Lights has been reclassified as 15+.

Some profanity has been removed or muted.

An After Story scene with explicit content has been deleted and replaced with another scene.

Descriptive scripts of sexual intercourse have been removed.

As with the CG additions made in Iruka’s After Story, new CGs will also be added later to Erie’s After Story.
Due to time constraints, the priority was delayed — thank you for your understanding.
[hr][/hr]2. Standing CG Replacement
All standing CGs created between 2022 and early 2023 have been replaced.

Iruka’s standing CG has been replaced.

Hari’s standing CG has been replaced.

Erie’s first-pose standing CG has been replaced.

Märchen’s first-pose standing CG has not yet been updated, but it will be included in the next major update.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44185487/e02d6707ebba5886f19d40dae1dc9f0c9160d0b2.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44185487/f38a38fcf9f70a2d03d453a9c6edf5be03cf38b5.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44185487/9757add4bce7af5b53ce9c740021b5d48eb765eb.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44185487/7e156b03e94cf380372dd2b997bb5bcf0fc9f01f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44185487/7633cd0caf95f82d26ee131935177a6fa47702ce.jpg"]
3. Iruka Route – Event CG Additions & Direction Changes


Around 15 new event CGs have been added to Iruka’s route.
Some unfinished elements will be completed and added later.
[hr][/hr]4. Music Updates
The music volume and quality in Hari’s route have been improved.

New versions of Iruka’s “Water Theme,” “Butterfly Effect,” and Krina’s theme song have been implemented.

If you purchased the OST, please re-download to access the updated tracks.

Around 2 more tracks in Iruka’s route will be updated later — please look forward to it.
[hr][/hr]5. UI Additions & Changes
Text speed adjustment has been re-added to the settings menu.

A master volume control has been added.

Option to toggle sound ON/OFF when the game is running in the background has been added.

A new “Back Jump” function has been added to the backlog.
→ Clicking it will return you directly to the scene where that line/description appeared.
Thank you for your patience.

HELP and control key guide have been added.
[hr][/hr]
when you compare the removed CGs or the toned-down violent scenes, there’s really not much difference. That’s because from the very beginning I designed them loosely, so they could be adjusted at any time.
This whole project goes through my hands, and nothing has ever been changed or altered due to outside pressure.
The reason I originally developed the game with an R18 rating was both to test how far my expressions could go, where the limits would be, and at the same time to avoid feeling stressed while creating it.
That test came to an end as I finished the third route, and I decided there was no longer any need to stay within the R18 rating.


Thank you very much.
